intent.raw: refine an API for Craft using the new ingested data
intent.objective: Produce a non-executed, implementation-ready design and Work Pack for a read-only Craft consultation API over the verified WaveDB snapshot while preserving source-ledger authority, schema-version compatibility, privacy, provenance, and runtime failure boundaries.
intent.operator_sentence: refine an API for Craft using the new ingested data

route_menu.context_hint: The verified store supports exact snapshot retrieval, but row normalization, refresh effects, write authority, and public/private placement are not yet proven.

items.label: Read-only contract first
items.description: Selected smallest coherent unit: snapshot discovery and consultation with provenance, followed by schema-aware row queries only when normalization validates.

items.label: Private refresh service
items.description: Deferred: adds a separately authorized rebuild command after freshness, locking, atomic replacement, and failure recovery are designed.

items.label: Read-write Craft API
items.description: Rejected for this refinement: WaveDB is not Craft authority and no deterministic source-ledger mutation route is admitted.

technique_overlays.trigger: The ten Refine stages form an ordered evidence, critique, repair, and planning chain.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every non-first step consumes prior evidence, every stage returns a native receipt or blocked reason, and missing evidence blocks synthesis.

technique_overlays.trigger: Read-only consultation, projection refresh, source mutation, and public/private placement have different owners and effects.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The read-only MVP is selected explicitly; refresh, mutation, and placement decisions remain separate and gated.

technique_overlays.trigger: API usefulness conflicts with source authority, privacy, freshness honesty, and storage limitations.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Named critic roles converge only when useful reads do not inherit write or promotion authority and stable disagreements remain residue.

technique_overlays.trigger: The ingested store currently contains raw documents and metadata, while row families and schema versions vary across ledgers.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The design names raw snapshot, normalized row, index, provenance, adapter, service, and transport components with concrete source handles.

technique_overlays.trigger: The API design can be falsified cheaply with fixture queries and known WaveDB failure modes before implementation planning.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Positive and negative scenarios cover reopen, mixed return types, stale snapshots, missing and duplicate IDs, unauthorized writes, and boundary leakage.

technique_overlays.trigger: One passing import and three failed attempts contain material design constraints that must not be erased.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The passing receipt and failed batch/type assumptions remain linked as evidence, not rewritten as success.

technique_overlays.trigger: The snapshot includes private DomainSpec and project ledgers while Arcanum is public.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: No private ledger content enters public Arcanum artifacts; generic contracts and private adapters keep separate owners and paths.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Three independent failure surfaces need adversarial review after the initial design: API contract coherence, Craft authority/privacy, and WaveDB runtime correctness.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Three read-only Interrogation critics can review one exact design corpus in parallel and return bounded receipts before parent-owned repair. The Refine parent retains definition, design, planning, synthesis, and all mutation authority.
context: The snapshot proof covers 27 current owner ledgers but not row-level normalization.
Live ledgers include multiple schema generations.
A 55-record atomic batch silently reopened without the manifest.
Large values may return as Buffer even when written as strings.
Private DomainSpec data must not leak into public Arcanum surfaces.

roles.purpose: Attack resource boundaries, stable identifiers, filters, pagination, errors, freshness semantics, cache behavior, and contract testability.
roles.owns: One read-only API-contract review receipt; no design, source, implementation, or final-synthesis authority.

roles.purpose: Attack source-ledger authority collapse, schema drift, row-ID ambiguity, stale projection claims, private-data leakage, and accidental write or promotion effects.
roles.owns: One read-only Craft authority review receipt; no ledger, schema, runtime, implementation, or final-synthesis authority.

roles.purpose: Attack reopen durability, batch behavior, mixed string/Buffer reads, snapshot replacement, locking, concurrency, corruption detection, and failure recovery assumptions.
roles.owns: One read-only WaveDB adapter review receipt; no dependency, store, implementation, or final-synthesis authority.

authorization_evidence.scope: The displayed ten-stage route and exactly three read-only design critics; no external research, product mutation, Craft-ledger mutation, deployment, publication, or Git operation.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Block if source authority, data sensitivity, schema coverage, or evidence provenance cannot be resolved without copying private ledger content.

steps.name: Invoke Define
stop_conditions: Block if the API cannot be defined without assigning WaveDB source authority or write effects.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review
convergence_criteria: The API is useful for snapshot consultation without owning Craft truth.
Private data, freshness, schema compatibility, and stable IDs have explicit owners and failure behavior.
WaveDB limitations are constraints, not silently repaired claims.
stop_conditions: Stop alternation after one critique and one parent synthesis; block unresolved authority or privacy contradictions.

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: External research is blocked unless a named material gap receives separate operator confirmation.

steps.name: Initial Distill
convergence_criteria: The selected unit is a read-only contract over a provenance-bound snapshot.
Row-level queries are conditional on version-aware normalization.
Refresh and source mutation remain separate deferred capabilities.
The unit recomposes into Craft without taking authority from YAML.

steps.name: Invoke Redefine and Design
stop_conditions: Block if the design requires public/private data collapse, unguarded refresh or mutation, or unsupported WaveDB durability assumptions.

steps.name: Governed three-critic design review
convergence_criteria: Endpoint semantics are deterministic, versioned, testable, and explicit about freshness.
WaveDB remains a derived read model and no API read gains source-write or promotion authority.
Private data and generic public contracts stay in separate namespaces.
Batch persistence and mixed return-type behavior have explicit adapter and test rules.
All three critic receipts are joined and terminal before repair.
stop_conditions: Block if any critic is unjoined, unclosed, missing its receipt, or finds an unresolved authority, privacy, or durability violation.

steps.name: Distill Repair and toy scenarios
stop_conditions: Block if a read request can mutate Craft or refresh the store.
Block if a stale or hash-mismatched snapshot can be presented as current truth.
Block if missing or duplicate row IDs can produce an authoritative-looking result.
Block if private source content can enter a public artifact or response without an explicit policy owner.
Block if the adapter relies on the failed multi-record batch path.

steps.name: Invoke Plan
stop_conditions: Block if the plan mixes public contract publication, private adapter implementation, source mutation, deployment, or promotion into an implicitly authorized action.

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
stop_conditions: Block pass if required stage artifacts or receipts are absent, the critic lifecycle is open, or claims exceed non-executed design and planning evidence.

gates.condition: REFINE-DISPATCH.json passes the dispatch schema and governance validator before any runtime-backed stage starts.
The operator explicitly confirms the ten-stage route and three read-only capability-bound critics.
Each runtime-backed stage resolves its native capability handle and expected receipt before execution; unavailable owners record exact blocked reasons.
.craft/ledger.yml remains source authority; WaveDB, API responses, indexes, plans, and receipts remain derived evidence or views.
Private ledger contents and private runtime details are not written into public Arcanum; generic contracts and private adapters have separate owner paths.
External research runs only after a named material gap and separate operator confirmation.
Every selected stage has its expected artifact plus a native receipt or an explicit blocked reason before downstream consumption.
All three design critics return declared receipts and reach terminal join and close states before Distill Repair.
The selected API design exposes no source mutation, projection refresh, promotion, publication, or deployment effect and fails closed on unsupported schema or stale provenance.
Final synthesis cites all stage artifacts and receipts, records residue, and claims only design and non-executed plan readiness.

promotion_guardrails: This route produces design and non-executed planning evidence only.
WaveDB never becomes Craft source authority.
API reads do not authorize source mutation, refresh, promotion, publication, deployment, or release.
Private DomainSpec ledger content cannot enter public Arcanum artifacts.
A passing Refine synthesis does not admit Craft runtime integration or production readiness.
